name: marikitaparty-website
description: Marikitaparty studio site, deployed to Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.deploy: rm -rf .deploy && mkdir -p .deploy && cp index.html odomo.html styles.css script.js .deploy/ && cp -R assets .deploy/ && wrangler pages deploy .deploy --project-name=marikitaparty --branch=main
scripts.deploy:preview: rm -rf .deploy && mkdir -p .deploy && cp index.html odomo.html styles.css script.js .deploy/ && cp -R assets .deploy/ && wrangler pages deploy .deploy --project-name=marikitaparty --branch=preview
